item.title: Inside Rick Ross’ ‘Port of Miami’ 20th Anniversary Tour Kickoff | Billboard Presents
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this special episode, where we're celebrating a hip-hop milestone. We're joined by the one and only Rick Ross, as he takes us behind the scenes of the 20th anniversary tour of his debut album, Port of Miami.
[Clip of Rick Ross speaking]
Rick Ross: We're kicking it off in Miami, just for the crib, just for the hustlers.
Host: That's right, Rick Ross is back in his hometown, reflecting on the legacy of Port of Miami and the hustle that built his empire. He's also talking about new music, business wins, and what still drives him two decades later.
Rick Ross: [Clip] I been working on Set in Stone for about a year, collecting the right production, making sure it's top-notch.
Host: From entrepreneurship to loyalty, and the city that made him, Rick Ross is opening up about it all. He's taking us on a journey through his career, and the mindset that's kept him at the top of his game.
[Clip of Rick Ross speaking]
Rick Ross: [laughs] You already know what it is, man. We out here for a lot of different reasons.
Host: Join us as we celebrate 20 years of Port of Miami with the big boss himself, Rick Ross. Stay tuned for more exclusive insights from the man behind the music.
[Outro music plays]
